Author: seathatflowsinourveins
Message:
Reconcile gap-wave-2 durable-memory receipts with on-disk evidence (no new checks)

Second independent review returned fix_required with seven findings; this
pass edits claims to match raw outputs already on disk and runs no check.

- Gap 14 settled -> advanced: only the unshare -rn arm ran, a device-less
  namespace cannot detect attempted egress, and the 3299 lo bytes span
  status + write-page.
- Gap 11 advanced -> not_settled: residue grep counted a path substring,
  not the token; TTL was exercisable via MCP/HTTP expires_at; the backup
  zgrep matched before the shred (live page, not erasure).
- Gap 2 deferred -> not_settled: unshare --pid --fork --mount-proc removes
  the stated process-guard blocker.
- Gaps 1 and 8 deferred -> not_settled: live status shows a native codex
  LLM provider, contradicting the stated blocker.
- Gap 12: one data-producing attempt, one snapshot; half (a) blockers do
  not hold. Gaps 5/13: sota-refresh evidence is on origin/main, not absent.
- Real transcript timestamps for every receipt (all late); raw transcript
  outputs and probe scripts committed under raw/ with INDEX.json hashes;
  results.json and the README outcome table generated from receipts.
- README leads with the unresolved live-store isolation breach for the
  operator's decision.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Message:
PR-5 packets unit: build layer-verdict lane packets, return schema, prompt

Adds tools/sota-convergence/lane_packets.py (one JSON packet per landscape
ledger layer, withholding the incumbent's own verdict, candidate-to-manifest
matching by normalized GitHub slug, seeded/stable candidate shuffle,
SHA256SUMS, leak/host-path-safe write discipline matching build_verdicts.py),
the fully-inlined draft 2020-12 lane-return.schema.json usable as a codex
--output-schema file, the verbatim shared lane-prompt.md, a synthetic fixture
root at tests/fixtures/lane-packets/ and tests/test_lane_packets.py, and the
new "Lane packets" README section.

Real-run smoke test against the worktree root produced exactly 32 packets
(20 foundation + 12 us-equities layers), byte-identical across two runs.
